correctness.rationale: The line-graph arm-state count is correct and yields the displayed general tripod formula. Substituting the path count \(q_t=(2tF_{t+1}-(t+1)F_t)/5\) into the \([P_2,P_2,P_c]\) and \([P_3,P_3,P_c]\) specializations reduces the gap to \(2(d-1)F_{d+1}-3dF_d\), with \(d=n-7\). Direct arithmetic gives positive gaps 26 and 186 at \(d=14,15\); for \(d\ge16\), \(5F_{d+1}-8F_d=F_{d-5}>0\) gives \(F_{d+1}/F_d>8/5\) and hence strict positivity. A fresh independent calculation reproduced the first several gaps and the closed formula. The finite all-tripod scan is correctly treated as supplementary only.
